description: The files brought from an old branch: the branch, the commit, the path there and the path here. A file of the working tree with the content of a file of an old branch that is not listed fails scripts/gates/branch.mjs.

only the formulas of the east, north and up frame, written again over the arrays of the computation; the memo at the top of the module, the scratch arrays at the top of the module, the range of the factors and the bringing of the first longitude within [-180, 180] are not brought

only the cases (the move to the point to, the twelve turns, the latitudes past the one of Web Mercator and the poles, the numbers past the longitude and the latitude, the fields, the features that keep their shape, the values taken), written again over the arrays; the ranges are not brought

the keys after, before and between keys, and their order by bytes, with the counting of the keys at an end written here in place of the functions of the format of the pages; the keys made many at a time are not brought, and createOrderKeyBetween is new

only the cases of the keys between two keys, of the keys that do not grow at an end over 100,000 items, of the keys after the rows of a page and of the keys made from any string, written again over createOrderKeyBetween; the cases of the keys made many at a time are not brought

only the folding of the rows by layer (a row created and deleted not told, deleted and created updated, the writes that only create kept as they came), of the updates by id, and of the order and the metadata to their values before and after; the hold of the change until the last write, the values before, the settling of the features and the selection are not brought

only the writes of the layers, the groups, the files and the metadata over the tables (the rows of a layer deleted in one write, a group the tables still know keeping its reference); the class, the transforms, the edits, the state of the client, the groups the Store deletes by itself and the members it moves are not brought

only the check that the parent of a row names a layer or a group before anything is written, and the errors of the tables made into errors of the library; the shapes made per row and the changes of the order are not brought

only the values before of a transaction taken from the first read of each row and field of its writes, and one write given as it is; read only for a transaction a listener asked them for, held by the layer the change lists each row in, the geometries gathered as the columns of their positions in place of a shape per row, the fields a later write brings read for the rows read before, and the arrays shared by the listeners

only the values before and the token that keeps the deleted rows carried by the change of a transaction, one token of the tables per transaction; asked per listener and per transaction, given to each listener in a change of its own with a token of its own over one counted entry, and the name DeletedRowsToken in place of restoreToken

only the builder and the merge of the pages over those of the tables with the columns of the rows, their errors made errors of the library, the Worker of the application as the tables hand it their work, and a row the tables build given to it with its geometry as GeoJSON; named createRowPageBuilder, mergeRowPages and RowPageWorker, the groups named by their ids and their places in place of their handles, the checks of the values of the store entry before a row is added; the rings of the Circles, the triangles of the fills and the deleted rows given to the builder are not brought
only the list of the buffers of pages to transfer, named getRowPageTransferList; the tables of the table entry it also took are not brought

only the depth of the shape of each of the six types of geometry; the reading of the positions into coordinates and the triangles of the fills are not brought (the builder of the tables reads the positions)

only a Worker that builds rows into pages and posts them with the transfer of their buffers, answering the request it is given; the reading of the files in parts, the batches, the rows picked at random and the rows of the edits are not brought, and the merges and builds a Store hands it are new

only the way the parts are cut: a budget of time per part, one transaction per part, the next part in a later task, the rows deleted meanwhile left out and the locked ones kept; told per part with the last part always told, applied first only to the features a write touches, and read through the public interface of the Store

the ledger, the limit of 64,000,000 bytes and the parts of the rows; the count of what was left behind belongs to the ledger of an instance, not to the module, the limit is not set by the application, the parts are named after the renderers here, and the frame buffer is a kind of its own
the tests of the ledger, with the count of what was left behind kept per ledger

only the GL that counts the storage it is asked for, the failures of the allocations and of the programs, the limit of the images and of the tables of the drape, and the check of the sources; the renderers of the rows and the allocations of the extensions are not brought, and the instances drawn on the GL, the objects counted by kind and the work of 1,000 and 10,000 features are new

the textures of the images recorded in the ledger under the limit: given up off the screen, drawn from a smaller picture, whole again when there is room, waiting when next to nothing is left, and given back after a time not drawn
only the rows of a table of the drape under the limit (rowsUnderLimit) and the record of the textures and of the mesh in the ledger; the drape of the rows is not brought
the writes in place of the texels and the instances of a chunk of rows, as they are
the builds of the chunks over the frames within a budget, with the origin chosen by the functions of the retained batches; the regions of the rows moved by a drag are not brought
the layout of the instances of the rows and the palette of the resolved styles; the pictures of the points of an extension and the marks of the ground are not brought

the branches of the kinds and the dashes of the segments of the program of the rows, written again on the projection and the formulas of the renderers of the features (flat map only); the globe, the terrain, the ground and the pictures are not brought
the chunks of rows on the GPU, their uploads and their writes in place, and the draw of a range; the variants of the projection, the ground, the heights and the pictures are not brought
the texture of one byte per row and its upload; the moving sets, their motions and the GPU of the extensions are not brought
the resolution of the styles of the rows and the packing of a row into a chunk drawn in one draw; the surfaces, the ground and the batches by kind are not brought
the classification of a row and the runs of a row group; the extensions that hold rows and the pictures are not brought

the drawing of the layers from their row groups and the parts of their deltas, the next versions, the state of the rows and the writes in place, written again over the reader of the built-in Store; the drape, the surfaces, the extensions and the moving sets are not brought

only the change of the style made once per kind of row (its type and its style), not once per row; the plan the Store applied and the rows read from inside the tables are not brought: the instance writes through its layer

only the scenes of the deletion of the selection (the locked ones kept, the selection cleared once something is deleted); the deletion in one write of the Store is not brought: the features are deleted in the parts of a bulk edit

only the bit per reference of a row, made when a row is first looked for; the references stay in the order of the set, and the rows are read through the layer over the Store, not through the types of Kasane
only the bound of a set of 100,000 rows held in less than 500,000 bytes
